carry: Pre-study: the Lean flow pre-study, section K13.
Seam with R10-ORCH-MACHINERY: read a live reviewer from the design's workers.json when it exists (else the review worktree heuristic); the beat's handoff job generalises this freeze to every head.

Self-test hygiene: (a) a new seat-selftest mutant in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py takes a per-file id (for example cloud_relay-1), never a new S number (the P6 convention); on 2026-10-21 three pull requests (R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD, R10-FLOW-YIELD-PROBE, R10-CI-LAYOUT's PR G) each lost a code round to a content conflict there when main gained tick_loop mutants S31-S34. (b) A self-test builds any git repository through tests/throwaway_git.py, never a hand-built git init (a pusher-reap handoff was refused for exactly that in tools/audit/seat/pr_args.sh); run python3 tests/throwaway_git.py --check before the handoff.
brief: The roster pull request as a frozen head, and carries that can name the round's roster (Lean flow study K13). Every roster_edit.py push lands on handoff/audit-r10-roster and the relay carries it into the open roster pull request, so a review of that pull request comes back head-moved or body-stale: #2559 lost five reviewer rounds that way on 2026-10-21. And carry_audit.py check resolves carry destinations against main's roster only, so a carry to a group that exists only on the handoff roster fails as a bad destination until the roster pull request merges: #2529, #2547 and #2561 were blocked by it. Change: (a) the relay does not move an open roster pull request's head while a review of it is in flight (a review worktree or an undisposed review dispatch for that number), the freeze fixer.md already gives a fix head; roster edits accumulate on the handoff ref and land between reviews; (b) carry_audit.py also reads the round's handoff roster ref (roster_lib.round_ref) as a destination source, naming which ref resolved each carry, so a destination on the handoff roster passes and one on neither still fails. carry_audit.py is code-owned: tvofi's review under the mandate. Controls: a fixture carry to a handoff-only group passes and names the handoff ref; a carry to a group on neither fails; the relay fixture with a review in flight leaves the roster head unchanged and moves it once the review posts; mutants for both arms.
